title: Jean Chen — Collect paper airplanes in your footer
note: A 14-second screen recording of the Sedrus website: cream, paper-textured design with red accents, and a footer where paper airplanes fly down from the hero collage and collect into a slot, under a giant embossed Sedrus serif wordmark. She dropped it with Love the footer. Her steals: the footer as a collection mechanic for her own motifs, and the giant embossed wordmark as a footer device — with the caution that the skew goes low-res. Captured date is the drop date; post is Nov 16.
